reviews.text: The subscription is not worth it and when I tried to contact their support to get a refund, they had no way to contact them. The website they use for support errors and does not send messages (as I’ve seen with other reviews) nor do they respond to direct emails to their “support email”. They also have no phone number to contact for support. Overall, I believe the subscription is a scam and the app is bad. Hope nobody has problems with their account, otherwise you will not be able to receive help. I had to dispute the charges with my bank.

reviews.title: Ever Heard Of Dark Mode?
reviews.text:
I have MS. My eyes are very sensitive to light backgrounded games. I can’t tolerate them. I looked and there was no way to switch to a Dark Mode setting. I can’t use this application unless this is an option. 

Don’t tell me to pay and then maybe I’ll have this choice. No, thank you.

reviews.title: Stole my money
reviews.text: I guess you people are wanting a bad review so I’ll give you one. I was charged the yearly subscription instead of giving me a free trial, I contacted support and they refused to give me back my money. I’m not going to use the app anymore and they still won’t give me my money. I sent screenshots of me not having a account with them and I made sure to send a screenshot of me being a new member, they still refused. F this team that is controlling this app, your app won’t make it very far here. I’ll make sure to get into contact with Apple support and find a way to report these scammers.
